notes: Gesture upgrade. The left pull from the Orb no longer opens a panel: Brightness, Volume, Ring, and Flashlight fan out from the Orb like a folding fan, and the same drag selects — glide to a control to light it, slide up or down on Brightness or Volume to set it, release on the Flashlight to toggle it or on Ring to step it to its next mode. Release with nothing lit and nothing changes. New: a Kinto controls tile for Android's quick settings (Settings → Launcher updates → Add controls tile) opens the same fan from inside any app.
